functional: native S0 plus mean full/spectral ROKS gaps; only response-operator transport changes from one global rotation to fixed covalent-neighborhood atomic rotations
clusters: breadth-first neighborhoods in the anchor graph, radius sums plus 0.28 angstrom, extended only until the fixed anchor cluster spans a noncollinear frame; never reselect along the geometry path
vertical_preservation: all local rotations are identity at the anchor; energies, Fock and electronic response remain identical to the previous calibrated 50/50 model for every density
derivatives: analytic first and second local Kabsch rotation jets; native GFN2 fixed-density derivatives and relaxed orbital Schur complements for all five stationary energy components
tracking: full local CSF >=0.7; original active pair compared in the same local atomic AO frame >=0.7; intercomponent active pair >=0.7; bounded adjacent-index following
optimization: maximum 160 additional accepted steps; damped BFGS with Armijo descent; if a stationary point has a vibrational frequency below -20 cm-1, up to two 0.05 angstrom displacements along the lowest exact mode
qualification: max gradient below 3e-5 Ha/bohr, no mode below -20 cm-1, positive component gaps, independent central energy/gradient and Hessian-vector checks at 2e-4 and 1e-4 bohr; no SCC invocation
sources: completed vertical states and last accepted molecular checkpoints reused, with explicit model migration and newly evaluated derivatives; no DFT SCF reruns or TBE-based root selection
validation_scope: acetaldehyde motivated the transport change; the other four molecules test transferability without fitting
